description: Ycéo - Arrêts de bus accessibles PMR is a dataset listed in Saint-Nazaire Agglo - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CARENE. Arrêts de bus du réseau Ycéo en accessibilité PMR (personnes à mobilité réduite). Coverage: Saint-Nazaire Agglomération (Loire-Atlantique). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport en commun, arrêt, accessibilité, Ycéo, bus, déplacement. The portal shows 418 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-saintnazaireagglo-fr-portal.
